b3c9e557f527aee90c6e1f4446eba5e7f8b5dc9e: Spital am Pyhrn – Wurzeralm is a small-scale, low-key resort: 22.5 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. The family reputation of Spital am Pyhrn – Wurzeralm is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The moderate altitude of Spital am Pyhrn – Wurzeralm, with its base at 810 m and summit at 1870 m, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. The budget for a stay at Spital am Pyhrn – Wurzeralm is clearly high: 55€ for a day pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but be aware of it before you set off. In short: Spital am Pyhrn – Wurzeralm does not rival the giants of skiing, and does not claim to. It is an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
